title: Morning Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Morning Sunwatch — October 20, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B6.2)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B9.7 (Peaked October 20, 2026 at 12:16 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 348 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.00)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G1 Predicted

Anyone else watching? 👀☀️

Several active regions and sunspot groups are visible today, while the surrounding corona appears otherwise routine.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 195 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
